mxfp4_kernel_finding.implementation: ggml_vec_dot_mxfp4_q8_0 invoked once per output row through the llamafile MXFP4 fallback
mxfp4_kernel_finding.current_isa: AArch64 NEON table lookup plus SDOT/DOTPROD
mxfp4_kernel_finding.source_contract: The frozen implementation deliberately avoids SVE and I8MM requirements.
mxfp4_kernel_finding.consequence: Turning SVE/BF16/I8MM CMake switches on without adding and qualifying a new MXFP4 kernel has no source-backed performance mechanism.
